title: Terms
body:
## Use of this website

[Placeholder] These terms govern the use of this website and the services described on it, including bookings, consultations and treatments provided by Dr Tranter Aesthetics. By using this website, you agree to be bound by these terms.

[Placeholder] Content on this website is provided for general information purposes only and does not constitute medical advice. It should not be used as a substitute for a consultation with a qualified practitioner.

## Bookings and cancellations

[Placeholder] Appointments booked through this website or by phone are subject to our cancellation policy. Patients are asked to provide at least [xx hours] notice of any change or cancellation; late cancellations or missed appointments may incur a fee.

[Placeholder] A deposit may be required to secure certain appointments or treatment courses, the terms of which will be confirmed at the time of booking.

## Payment

[Placeholder] Payment for treatments is due at the time of service unless otherwise agreed in writing. Prices are subject to change and will be confirmed prior to treatment.

## Consent

[Placeholder] Written, informed consent is required before any treatment is performed. Consent may be withdrawn by the patient at any point prior to or during a procedure.

## Changes to these terms

[Placeholder] Dr Tranter Aesthetics reserves the right to update these terms from time to time without prior notice. The current version will always be available on this page, and continued use of the website constitutes acceptance of any changes.
